data.name: Olympe
data.gender_notes: Olympe is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Olympe was the name of the goddess of mountains and fertility. In Christianity, it can be given to a girl as a reminder of her strong and stable character, inspired by the mountain goddess. The name Olympe carries the meaning “Goddess of the mountains” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Olympe usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of the mountains and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strength, stability, and resilience in the face of challenges.
data.etymology: Olympe belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of the mountains.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Olympe total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: אולימפה
in_hebrew.meaning: אולימפה - שיא הר גבוה, מקום של שגיון וקדושה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אולימפה הוא שם שמקורו ביוונית ומתייחס לשיאו של הר אולימפוס, מקום מיתולוגי של האלים ביוון העתיקה. בהקשר הנוצרי, השם עשוי לסמל מקום של שגיון וקדושה, קשור לרוחניות גבוהה ושאיפה לקדמה.

in_greek.name: Ολύμπη
in_greek.meaning: Ολύμπη - κορυφή του Ολύμπου, τόπος θεοτήτων
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Ολύμπη είναι όνομα που προέρχεται από την κορυφή του Ολύμπου, το σπίτι των θεών στην ελληνική μυθολογία. Στην χριστιανική παράδοση, το όνομα μπορεί να συμβολίζει υψηλή πνευματικότητα και αναζήτηση της θεότητας.

in_latin.name: Olympa
in_latin.meaning: Olympa - mountain peak, dwelling place of gods
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Olympa originates from the Latinized form of the Greek name for Mount Olympus, the dwelling place of the gods in ancient mythology. In Christian tradition, it may signify a lofty spiritual aspiration or a pursuit of divine heights.

in_english.name: Olympe
in_english.meaning: Heavenly, mountain peak, dwelling place of gods
in_english.long_meaning: The name Olympe, derived from Greek roots, refers to the peak of Mount Olympus, the mythological home of the gods. In Christian context, it symbolizes a lofty spiritual aspiration, a pursuit of divine heights, and a connection to the transcendent. Historically, the name may evoke a sense of grandeur and spiritual quest.

data.cultural_impact: In Greek mythology, Olympe was a mountain goddess associated with fertility and the protection of mountain peaks. Her name is derived from the Greek word "olBus," meaning "mountain." Naming a child Olympe in this context may evoke a sense of strength, stability, and connection to nature. As a Christian family, this cultural significance can serve as a reminder of the endless power and provision of God, symbolized by the mountains.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian symbolism, the name Olympe can be infused with deeper meaning beyond the Greek goddess. It can represent Olympic-like dedication and perseverance in the face of challenges. The child named Olympe is called to climb the mountains of life, bravely conquering adversity and obstacles with faith and determination. Spiritually, this name also honors the biblical Mount of Transfiguration, where God revealed His divine glory to St. Peter, James, and John. In this context, the spiritual significance of the name Olympe is a powerful reminder of the transfiguring power of God that transforms and elevates us to a higher state of consciousness and spiritual awareness.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Olympe, meaning "helper of the gods" or "heavenly one" in Greek mythology, carries a symbolism of divine assistance and connection to the divine realm in Christian tradition. It evokes a sense of spiritual protection and celestial grace.
